attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count is dominated by shared-prefix traversal. Constant-time block-list cardinality and endpoint reference-count checks should distinguish immediate exits, partial sharing, and full traversal.

pcvs.name: request_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Bounds the number of loop iterations.

pcvs.name: first_block_shared
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes immediate termination from traversal of a shared prefix.

pcvs.name: fully_shared_length
pcvs.rationale: A shared final block indicates likely full traversal, including the single-request case.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures changes in sharing conditions across request batches.
